card.name: Bird descriptions and waterfowl text
card.fires_on: Spaces and small words inside bird-related text, especially right before a bird measurement such as length or wingspan, or in waterfowl and bird-collision passages.

modes.label: Before bird measurements
modes.description: The space right before a number in a bird's length or wing measurement.
modes.example: Lesser Snow Goose Latin: Anser caerulescens caerulescens Average length: M<< >>29", F 28"

modes.label: Waterfowl and bird passages
modes.description: Word endings or small words inside text about ducks, geese and birds.
modes.example: The most positive news coming out of this year’s survey continues to be for redheads, green-wing<<ed>> teal and scaup.

card.writes: It seems to push against bird words such as feathers, bird and birds, so the bird topic is not named next.
card.plain: It fires in bird descriptions, mostly just before a size measurement, and pushes the model away from saying bird words.
